fullAccess.title: Enable full access?
fullAccess.message: Full access lets the assistant run shell commands and edit files without asking for approval each time. Enable full access?

cookieImport.title: Confirm cookie import
cookieImport.messageHost: Import cookies for {{hostname}} from {{browser}} profile "{{profile}}" into Oleafly's in-app browser? Imported cookies may sign you in to websites.
cookieImport.messageAll: Import all cookies from {{browser}} profile "{{profile}}" into Oleafly's in-app browser? Imported cookies may sign you in to websites.

trustFolder.title: Trust this folder?
trustFolder.message: Oleafly will turn on Git, the terminal, agents and LaTeX tools for {{name}}. Only trust folders whose contents you know.
trustFolder.messageParent: Oleafly will trust {{name}} and every folder inside it, including ones you open later.
trustFolder.messageRepository: Oleafly will run Git in {{name}} with the repository's own settings and hooks.

restrictedWrite.title: Allow this change?
restrictedWrite.message: The assistant wants to change {{path}}. Files like this can run programs, and this folder isn't trusted yet.

restrictedNetwork.title: Allow this request?
restrictedNetwork.message: The assistant wants to use {{tool}}, which sends text to an online service. This folder isn't trusted yet.

rebindFolder.title: Use a different folder?
rebindFolder.message: {{name}} isn't the folder Oleafly had for this project. If you use it, Oleafly saves your unsaved changes there and closes this project's terminals and agent sessions. Anything running in them ends. Oleafly also stops trusting the folder, turns off Full Access, resets the assistant's approvals and unlinks research folders. Chats and history are kept.

saveCopy.title: Choose where to save a copy

errors.fullAccessDismissed: The full access confirmation was dismissed.
errors.approvalDialogClosed: The native approval dialog closed unexpectedly.
